budget_review.generation_explanation: (6000 collection + 28800 diagnostic including prefixes + 19200 heldout) * 64. Prefix replay does not generate, so this is conservative. Per-model heldout maximum 48*100*64=307200 fits 350000.
budget_review.scoring_upper: Two references x 1440 actions x context2048 = 5898240 padded forward-token upper, below7000000; target-token upper two x1440x64=184320 below500000. Additional score calls/retries cannot be hidden outside the ledger.
budget_review.training_upper: 800 action examples x64=51200 target tokens per arm, below2000000; actual per-arm token audit/final-state equality still required. 400+400 exposures and equal updates do not imply equal total compute.
budget_review.feasibility_limit: 38.5h sum of stated stage caps fits48h with9.5h residual. All waits/verification/cleanup count against one monotonic deadline; this is not a throughput guarantee. Maximum pool/candidate replan overhead may dominate CPU stage time. Hitting any cap must preserve incomplete status and stop rather than enlarge budget.

estimand_review.zero_difference_for_unavailable: Honest for the explicitly defined average incremental value over36 preregistered intervention slots with a common no-intervention fallback. It is an availability-weighted operational estimand, not success rate among available anchors and not an imputation that unobserved Q=0.
estimand_review.recommended_exact_definition: For scientifically eligible slots h, Dqu_h=sum_a q_h(a)Q_h(a)-mean_a Q_h(a), Dqe_h=sum_a q_h(a)Q_h(a)-Q_h(expert). For prespecified structural unavailability define both intervention differences0, retain Q/V as null and status reason. Report mean_h D over all36 and the explicit availability counts; optional available-only contrast is descriptive and cannot replace the frozen gate.

required_clarification.issue: Candidate uses already-terminated/unsupported/unavailable/no-certified-expert phrasing; unsupported runtime/prompt/replay behavior must not become scientific zero-difference missingness.
required_clarification.resolution: Before execution enumerate structural statuses (terminated before anchor; no certified planner baseline after normally completed oracle attempts) separately from exceptions, replay/hash mismatch, token-context error, budget exhaustion or missing certificate/Q. The latter makes the entire diagnostic incomplete and no gate decision. Missing candidate Q inside an otherwise eligible pool also stops; do not drop actions or renormalize q.

estimand_review.teacher_vs_learner: Teacher certificate defines only finite-set reachability by the planner within remaining original100-action horizon. ActualQ is a separately executed forced first action then frozen learner rollout from identical actual history; teacher success, likelihood/NLL and critic estimates cannot substitute. Different successor states are intentional. Dynamic planner first action itself must be successfully certified so Ve and all arm labels have common support.
estimand_review.gate_limits: At least12 multiaction anchors across4families and8 anchors with actualQ variation establish operational variation, not statistical significance or novelty. Expected q-weighted Q and the one realized frozen q-label draw are different objects; report both as defined, do not describe expected value as observed sampled-label outcome.
estimand_review.freeze_order: Complete learner trajectories and pools; lock all proposals/failures/certificates; score and freeze q, one uniform draw and one conditional draw for all eligible anchors; finish all available36-slot actualQ branches before outcome access. Q cannot filter training anchors, change labels or rescue thresholds.

controls_review.primary: Reference conditional recovery versus ordinary native-expert recovery on identical learner histories and common continued BC initialization, with fresh optimizer and identical400BC+400recovery exposure schedule.
controls_review.required_secondary: Reference conditional versus uniform from same certified sets. Frozen BC is useful acquisition-benefit context but insufficient to establish projection-specific gain.
controls_review.paired_evaluation: Lock all three final adapters before any of four48-task evaluations. Complete192 episodes and validate transitions/outcome derivation before contrasts. Missing technical records =>192 explicit statuses/null outcomes, no partial contrast; retain whether unblinding already began.
controls_review.interpretation_boundary: Reference chosen by canonical-BC role after prior dev results known is disclosed exploratory design. One seed/seen-task sample cannot establish independent episode significance, reference-adaptation causal effect, general arbitrary-state planner validity or unseen generalization.

A glob cannot prove no historical evaluation was stored elsewhere or removed. Existing phase0/phase1/same60 source paths use outputs and dev24; no outcome-based filter is needed.

If a prior unseen record is encountered, stop rather than continue claiming unopened unseen; failure report must not falsely claim it read no such metadata.
Bind candidate, producer, filter, manifest/report and original runtime/source/game inventories in later adoption; this script alone does not authorize subsequent acquisition.
Scene overlap remains disclosed. Training identity exclusion is the registered rule; do not silently substitute stronger train recipe exclusions after seeing quotas.
